title: Accept UTF-8 BOM encoded Staging convergence JSON inputs

phases.objective: Allow the canonical Staging environment convergence bridge to parse Windows PowerShell UTF-8 JSON files with one leading BOM while preserving exact-SHA, preflight, safety, environment-isolation, and fail-closed validation.

e2e_journeys.terminal_outcome: BOM-encoded runtime-state and schema/governance preflight JSON produced by Windows PowerShell are accepted by the real convergence bridge, while all existing exact-commit and safety boundaries remain fail-closed and Production mutation remains forbidden.
steps: Write synthetic runtime-state and Staging schema/governance preflight fixtures with an actual leading UTF-8 BOM.
Invoke the canonical Staging environment convergence bridge against those fixtures using an exact synthetic 40-character commit.
Normalize at most one leading BOM before JSON.parse and perform the existing convergence validation unchanged.
Require a successful not_required classification only when runtime, certification, preflight, exact commit, and safety evidence are valid.
Keep provider, workflow-dispatch, database, secret, and Production mutation authority disabled.
assertions: A single leading UTF-8 BOM does not cause staging_convergence_input_invalid for otherwise valid JSON evidence.
The bridge still rejects malformed JSON and does not weaken exact SHA or preflight validation.
The output exact commit equals the supplied synthetic exact commit.
provider_mutation, workflow_dispatch, production_mutation, database_mutation, and secrets_included remain false.
No Production deploy, provider mutation, database mutation, Breakglass, or authority widening is introduced by this change.
